channel.title: Articles by Saumya Bhandari
channel.description: Essays, ideas, and research on intelligence, physics, and philosophy.

item.title: How Words Build a World
item.description: How context changes meaning. Fifty everyday examples, from the two meanings of ‘bank’ to the mathematics of memory and identity.

item.title: What If Memory Could Travel as a Ripple?
item.description: Information Theory 2: a thought experiment about vibrating charges, messages in waves, and a computer that listens to electromagnetic space.

item.title: When Light Takes Time
item.description: From Einstein’s clock tower to the double slit: an illustrated journey through delayed light, moving observers, and quantum possibilities.

item.title: What If the Particle Was Already Everywhere?
item.description: Feynman’s many paths, waves, and knots. An exploration of particles as localized manifestations of something already everywhere.

item.title: Relativistic Plasma-Lensing and Quantum Interference
item.description: A research hypothesis connecting material fields, classical caustics, and quantum interference, with its mathematical claims and outstanding tests.

item.title: A Cubic Cancellation and a Fifth-Order Obstruction
item.description: Localized fermion modes, perturbative mass corrections, and the scalar response. A concise technical note in spectral theory.

item.title: Spontaneous Complex Order on a Stable Interface
item.description: A real scalar action, a localized complex order, an exact energy bound, and a stable fluctuation spectrum.

item.title: Context-Lifted Predictive States
item.description: The complete theory manuscript on representation complexity, nested discourse, and referential symmetry. Definitions, proofs, and the original paper.
